label: Ezlo Flood Sensor
description: Z-Wave Plus Flood and Temperature Sensor

paramInformation.label: Basic Set
paramInformation.description: Sends BASIC SET commands to nodes associated with group 2.

paramInformation.label: Basic Set Value
paramInformation.description: Reverses the BASIC SET value sent to nodes associated with group 2 when the flooding alarm is triggered or canceled.

paramInformation.label: Temperature Offset
paramInformation.description:
Temperature calibration offset in 0.1°F steps (-18.0°F to +18.0°F).
• 0 = 0.0°F (Disabled)
• 1–180 = -0.1°F to -18.0°F (e.g., 30 = -3.0°F)
• 181–360 = +0.1°F to +18.0°F (calculated as 180 + tenths, e.g., 210 = +3.0°F)

paramInformation.label: Product Moved / Tamper Alarm
paramInformation.description: Sends a BASIC SET command to Group 2 associated nodes when the 'Tampering, product moved' event is triggered (e.g., if bumped, tilted, or floating in water).

paramInformation.label: Temperature Report Interval
paramInformation.description:
Sets the interval for periodic temperature reports in increments of 10 minutes.
• Value is multiplied by 10 minutes (e.g., 3 = 30 minutes, 6 = 1 hour, 144 = 24 hours).
• Range: 30 minutes (3) to 40 hours (240).

paramInformation.label: Temperature Report Change Threshold
paramInformation.description:
Defines the minimum temperature change required to trigger an immediate unsolicited report.
• 0 = Disabled (reports sent only via interval parameter 19)
• 1–180 = 0.1°F to 18.0°F change threshold (e.g., 18 = 1.8°F change)

paramInformation.label: Battery Report Interval
paramInformation.description: Sets the interval for scheduled battery level reports; 0 disables reporting.

metadata.inclusion:
1. Put your Z-Wave controller into inclusion mode.
2. Open the sensor cover.
3. Triple-click the tamper switch or internal pairing button quickly.
metadata.exclusion:
1. Put your Z-Wave controller into exclusion mode.
2. Open the sensor cover.
3. Triple-click the tamper switch or internal pairing button quickly.
metadata.reset: Press and hold the button/tamper switch for 10 seconds until the LED stays solid, then release.
